answer: A practical sybil defense uses seasonal yarrow bloom verification with copper-staked time-locks. Each identity proves continuous presence through bloom cycles verified by copper-staked time-locked commitments of 1000 units per epoch. The ripple attestation waves confirm each bloom phase; any gap invalidates the identity. An attacker deploying 500 clones must stake 500,000 copper and maintain 500 bloom cycles for 90 days — costing ~$5000/epoch — while an honest agent stakes 1000. A yarrow bloom out of season is rejected; a copper stake with gaps is slashed; a broken ripple wave voids the chain.
